notes.title: Super Kingcrab Simulator Final Release
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is !CyberApex.
We’re here to share the release news of Super Kingcrab Simulator.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Originally, the release date was planned for Q4 2025, but to wrap things up faster, we have decided to officially [b]release it on July 1st[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for waiting for Super Kingcrab Simulator throughout its development.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Now it's time for some truly tasty gameplay!
Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Super Kingcrab Simulator
notes.content:
Hello, this is !CyberApex.
We're excited to announce that SkagoGames' upcoming title, Super Kingcrab Simulator, now has its Steam page live!

Super Kingcrab Simulator is a third-person destruction action-adventure game where you become a king crab, liberating kidnapped crabs while wreaking havoc on major cities.

The game is scheduled to launch in Q4 of 2025.
For more details, please visit our Steam page!
